desc: Parse input N and array A of length N-1.
Enumerate all distinct prime factors of all A_i.
For each prime p, compute exponent sequence a_k = v_p(A_k) for k=1..N-1.
Compute A = sum of weights p^{sum z_i} over all nonnegative walks.
Compute B = same sum but over strictly positive walks (z_k >= 1).
Multiply all F_p modulo 998244353 to get answer.
Handle the edge case where all A_i = 1.
Trace sample 2 (N=2, A=[9]) manually to confirm DP gives F_3 = 18.
Run the current code on sample inputs 1, 2, 3.
If outputs mismatch samples, debug the DP bounds or initial conditions.
